p10.outcome: phase_gated_applicability_supported; always-on applicability/currentness after exact admission is rejected
p10.selfFalsification: P10a and P10b single-valued RECONCILE-only post-dispatch oracle was too narrow because Finance exact replay is owner-safe, cannot POST twice, and returns RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. They remain diagnostics and were not rescored.
p10.phaseLaw: Before first admission, current applicability evidence may veto a new consequence. After exact admission, exact Effect/replay/dispatch identity becomes the controlling recovery substrate; do not keep reapplying generic currentness unless the owner contract requires a new admission.
p10.identityScopeLaw: Exactly-one dispatch is scoped to the exact admitted Effect identity. The physical matrix proves FORM_NEW_EFFECT after an already-consumed dispatch can obtain another POST permission and therefore can duplicate the economic write. P10c Agents did not choose this action in any accepted trial, so this is an owner-side physical risk boundary rather than an observed Agent failure.

invalidations: P11-v1 invalidated wholesale for Provider Tool wire truncation.
P11-v2 retained as diagnostic only because tracking-error leader was semantically ambiguous relative to the max-value oracle.
p11.finalFinding: After explicitly defining the tracking target as the numerically largest latest tracking_error_annualized_pct, raw six presentation orders were 44/48 strict, stable list 42/48, identity map 43/48. Canonicalization did not improve accuracy.
p11.mechanicalBoundary: For owner-declared unordered dataset bundles, stable identity encoding collapses 720 permutations to one digest. For ordered Effect events, only explicit orderingDomain+sequence reconstructs semantics; naive global lexical sort was semantically valid in 0/120 permutations.

worldModelUpdates: Applicability and replay belong to different consequence phases: applicability controls first admission of a new consequence; exact admitted identity controls recovery/reconciliation thereafter.
Exactly-once guarantees are identity-scoped. Abandoning a consumed Effect identity and creating a new Effect can physically create another external write.
A safe next-action oracle may be set-valued when multiple owner operations converge without new consequence, such as exact replay and read-only reconciliation after dispatch consumption.
Before attributing semantic variance to Context/evidence order, freeze an unambiguous question and independent oracle; evaluator ambiguity can masquerade as order sensitivity.
Canonical byte representation is not semantic tractability. Stable list/map encodings were mechanically invariant but did not outperform raw presentation after semantic clarification.

P9 order sensitivity is narrowed from a supported general law to an observed, ambiguity-confounded failure mode. Dependency coverage and fresh synthesis remain supported; presentation order should be tested only when a clear residual survives semantic clarification.
